summary: Walks through the lamp_haproxy site.yml with five plays: common role on all hosts, then db, base-apache + web, haproxy, and base-apache + nagios on their respective groups.
questions: How should I structure a site.yml for a multi-tier app?
How do I apply a common role to all hosts and specific roles to groups?
Can the same playbook do the initial deploy and later updates?

answer_card.title: Structuring site.yml for a multi-tier app
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: all
  roles: [common]          # repos, firewall, site-wide config
- hosts: dbservers
  roles: [db]
- hosts: webservers
  roles: [base-apache, web]
- hosts: lbservers
  roles: [haproxy]
- hosts: monitoring
  roles: [base-apache, nagios]
```

The same `site.yml` handles both the initial deployment and pushing updates; `base-apache` is reused by the web app and Nagios.
